description: A surface that groups content with shared spacing and corners. Choose outlined, subtle or elevated; standard or expressive treatment independently follows the theme's material. Tones change colour without changing geometry. All slots are optional; content uses the default slot. Omit the header to keep the title and description together in the body. Use ActionBar in the actions slot, with the main action in its primary slot. CardGroup aligns these regions with native subgrid; ordinary cards keep their stacked layout.
summary: A surface that groups related content.
